faqs.a: Nomi has a free plan that covers core generation. Paid plans add higher limits, more languages, and AI podcasts.

faqs.q: Can Nomi work with my PDFs and lectures?
faqs.a: Yes. Upload a PDF, import a YouTube link, or paste notes — Nomi structures the material into notes, flashcards, mind maps, quizzes, and a study guide.

faqs.q: How does Nomi help me remember?
faqs.a: Every flashcard and quiz feeds spaced repetition, so Nomi shows you cards right before you'd forget them. That spacing is what moves material into long-term memory.

faqs.q: Does Nomi do my homework for me?
faqs.a: No. Nomi helps you learn the material — notes, flashcards, and quizzes — rather than writing assignments for you.
Accuracy depends on your uploaded source; the AI can be wrong. Verify key facts before exams.

faqs.q: Can I use Nomi on my phone?
faqs.a: Nomi is a web app that works in mobile browsers. A native app is not currently available.
